en.head: In 2018, domestic salt accounted for 64.2% and milk for 84.2%
en.body: The doctrine sets domestic-market share thresholds for food: at least 90% for milk and 85% for salt. It specifies no deadline. A draft Agriculture Ministry report on the state program gave 2018 domestic shares of 64.2% for salt, 84.2% for milk, and 94.9% for potatoes (against a 95% threshold).
en.meta_context: Decree No. 120, “On Approving the Food Security Doctrine of the Russian Federation”
